request: 이거 업로드 해주고 이거 저세상개발자 내용이랑 겹치네 다른거 특별한걸로 또 찾아줘~
scope: Research five alternatives; no second production on this KST date and no new upload/publication authorization for these candidates.

comparison.coverage: Public loaded Shorts titles and links, plus supplied screenshots; not a complete transcript audit or an assertion of unique worldwide coverage.

confirmedOverlap.title: 게임 창문 속 방이 전부 가짜인 이유

comparison.selectionRule: Compare the demonstrated mechanism and reveal, not just title wording. Prefer specific developer-documented implementation decisions over another broad graphics trick. Recheck the candidate's actual clips before locking a script.

recommendationReason: A time-travel effect revealed as spatial teleportation is visually immediate; two stacked stages and a shared player position provide a clear one-variable Unity explanation. The exact implementation is confirmed by direct interviews with its developers.

candidates.title: 시간여행 버튼이 사실 위아래 이동이었다?
candidates.technique: Spatial teleportation between aligned level variants / 정렬된 두 레벨 사이 순간이동
candidates.termNote: A descriptive implementation name, not a claimed proprietary algorithm name.

primarySources.kind: Direct developer interview originally in Edge
primarySources.speaker: Steve Fukuda, game director
primarySources.readScope: Effect and Cause discussion and The cost of a great idea, including two buildings stacked vertically and player teleportation.

primarySources.kind: Direct interview with level designer Jake Keating
primarySources.readScope: Two aligned maps, past above present, fixed-distance transfer while moving; full article read for context.

candidates.referenceVideoStatus: Official Respawn commentary title/channel identified; not claimed fully watched or transcribed in this research pass.
visualPlan: Independent actual time-shift gameplay
Pull observer camera out to reveal two vertically aligned stages
Transfer the same player position between variants
Return to the same obstacle in the actual game
limits: Do not call this simulation of the world's past or actual rewind.
Do not invent the distance, frame cost or memory usage.
Recreating the arrangement does not expose the game's actual internal coordinates.
candidates.overlapAssessment: No matching time-shift implementation title among the 70 inspected. Network hit-rewind in that list is a different mechanism.
candidates.productionStatus: research-only; independent FHD footage, rights and clip review still required

candidates.title: 작은 물건을 멀리 놓았더니 진짜 커졌다?

primarySources.speaker: Phil Fortier, Graphics Programmer, Pillow Castle
primarySources.readScope: Held object maintains apparent screen size and moves to the farthest viable position; many rays cover the visible surface; real size and secondary behavior change.

visualPlan: Actual object changes usable size
Player view and observer view share one timeline
Hold apparent size while changing distance and world size
Demonstrate the newly large object as a platform
limits: Do not reduce the implementation to one center ray; the developer describes many surface rays.
This changes object scale; it is not merely changing FOV.
candidates.overlapAssessment: No matching title among the inspected set. Distinct from camera speed, oversized doors and flat-window rendering.
candidates.productionStatus: research-only; independent FHD footage, rights and clip review still required

candidates.title: 불에 안 타는 낙엽, 개발자는 바람으로 고쳤다
candidates.technique: Particle wind emitter / 파티클 바람 방출기와 상승기류

primarySources.speaker: Matt Vainio, Lead VFX Artist, Sucker Punch
primarySources.readScope: Wind and Leaves and Duels sections. QA noticed unburnt leaves in campfires; an upward wind emitter was added to keep most falling leaves out.

visualPlan: Actual campfire and surrounding leaves if a clear licensed capture can be secured
Own particle test shows leaves entering the fire
Enable upward wind only
Leaves lift away; explain avoiding a conspicuous mismatch
limits: The fix kept most leaves out; it did not guarantee that no leaf enters fire.
Do not claim all leaves burn or that combustion simulation was implemented.
Use an own labeled reconstruction for the before-state if no actual historical build is available.
candidates.overlapAssessment: Specific VFX bug fix absent from inspected titles. More distinctive than another broad wind/navigation or flow-field explanation.
candidates.productionStatus: research-only; first ensure that actual footage clearly shows the phenomenon

candidates.title: 동작을 끊어 바꿨는데 왜 자연스러울까?

primarySources.speaker: David Bollo, The Coalition / Microsoft
primarySources.readScope: Pages 0–44: crossfade cost, immediate target-animation transition, decaying pose offset and velocity, overshoot restrictions.

visualPlan: Actual animation direction change
One rig shows abrupt switch versus offset decay at the same instant
Overlay the decaying difference and resulting pose
Return to real movement
limits: Not a complete physical body simulation.
Do not promise a universal frame-rate multiplier.
The useful distinction is avoiding continued evaluation of both source and target animations during a transition.
candidates.overlapAssessment: No matching title among the inspected set; Bézier easing is adjacent but does not explain animation-transition inertialization.
candidates.productionStatus: research-only; actual footage alone cannot prove the internal algorithm
